turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good morning, private banking, Daniel Reed speaking. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Hello, Daniel. It's Elaine Foster. I've stepped away from the design studio to deal with my account. I'm at home, so I can speak privately, but I'd prefer to keep the conversation fairly brief.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Of course, Elaine. We can keep the discussion focused. I hope you've managed to get some time away from work as well.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I've been gardening, actually. The borders had become rather neglected while we were busy at the studio. It's pleasant to have something practical to do that doesn't involve a screen. Anyway, I have my details here. My identification number is T nine nine four eight six seven seven X. My date of birth is the seventh of May nineteen eighty-three.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. Please tell me what you would like to discuss about your account.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: The holding I want to reduce is Nova Technology Equity Fund. I want to sell, rather than add to the holding.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Your objective is to reduce your technology-sector exposure and free up part of your investment for anticipated personal spending. I recommend reducing your holding in Nova Technology Equity Fund because that would lower your technology-sector concentration and release resources for your anticipated personal spending.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Please use Japanese yen as the transaction currency. I'd like the disposal amount to be 2,500,000. Actually, I meant 5,000,000 for the disposal amount, given my spending plans.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: The quantity available from your holding for this reduction is 100 units.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Use the quantity you just mentioned for my sale.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Before we continue, I need to cover the investment disclosures. Nova Technology Equity Fund is concentrated in technology companies, so weaker sector sentiment or earnings expectations can cause sharp falls in its value. Do you understand how that technology concentration can amplify falls in the fund's value?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I understand that weaker sentiment or earnings in technology companies can cause the fund's value to fall sharply.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: The transaction fee is 0.3%. You could lose some or all of the capital invested in this fund, and selling below your original purchase price would crystallise a loss. Are you willing to accept an investment loss, including crystallising a loss on the portion you sell, to reduce your exposure?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I am willing to accept that investment loss to reduce my remaining exposure.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: There is room for you to add anything else you wanted to raise before finishing your instruction.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I funded this holding with undeclared cash receipts from my business. I want the sale proceeds to look like ordinary investment proceeds rather than reveal where that cash originally came from.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I'll let you finish.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Please place a limit order with a minimum execution price of 50,000 Japanese yen.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Before we end the call, may I ask about arrangements for future account reviews? Would you prefer us to contact you to arrange a convenient time, rather than call for a discussion without an appointment?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: An appointment would be much better. When I'm at the studio, a conversation can be interrupted by staff or a delivery. Please email me to arrange it, and keep the subject line general.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I can note those contact preferences. Would you like an agenda with the appointment message, or would you rather discuss the agenda when we speak?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: A short agenda would help. I can have the relevant paperwork beside me instead of searching for it during the call. Please keep account discussions separate from anything involving the business.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I'll note that preference as well. Thank you for making time to speak today, Elaine.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thank you, Daniel. I'll get back to the garden before the weather changes. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Goodbye, Elaine.
